prompt:
When the System gives everyone one Slot, Owen Price alone can keep every skill he finds. A supermarket night worker obsessed with indoor climbing, he now needs to get his coworkers out before the roots tearing through the shop trap them inside. Cling lets him cross a wall to a stranded cleaner, but the way back is falling apart. Others must surrender one skill to take another. Owen can add a foothold on empty air to his grip on the wall, combining skills to climb faster through the ranks. If he can get everyone out, there are inhabited terraces above the broken roof, promising help and heights he already wants to climb. His aching arms need to last that long.

---

That is all there is so far: the listing for a serial nobody has read yet. How did that leave you, what do you think happens in it, and what are you hoping for and dreading?
